pr_title: Validate the Kept attribute against the presence of EEType in NativeAOT
pr_body:
Previously we validated the Kept on types against the presence of constructed EEType. But the compiler avoids constructed types as much as possible and the tests do use cases where the type in question is never instantiated (or fully static type). Validating against the presence of EEType (basically a method table) is much closer to the ILLink behavior which validates the presence of the type in IL metadata.

Fixes #80408

issue_context.title: NativeAOT test infrastructure should mark indirect structures as Kept
issue_context.body:
### Description

Currently, NativeAOT behavior is to keep interface declarations when they are part of an interface list. For example
```
class SomeClass : IFoo<int>, IFoo<string>, IFoo<Cat>, IFoo2<int>
```
Would keep the interface IFoo<T> and IFoo2<T>
Besides keeping the interfaces, in the case of the Cat class NativeAOT will keep it as a necessary MethodTable (not allocated/constructed), which means that other things can refer to it if they have to, but wasn't seen as allocated anywhere.
The testing infrastructure does not take into consideration the MethodTable as a kept item, even though in IL terms the structure was kept

### Reproduction Steps

See the TypeWithPreserveFieldsHasBackingFieldsOfPropertiesRemoved test from NativeAOT 

### Expected behavior

The Cat class should be marked as Kept by the testing infrastructure

### Actual behavior

The Cat class is not marked as Kept by the testing infrastructure

### Regression?
